raidSayLines.line: A person, maybe 30s, with a nervous tic: "We've got days of stores, not weeks. The treeline is the pantry now. Learn what's out there."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
The raccoon with too many fingers stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
